source_instruction: i am looking for travel foaming dispenser for hand soap. please choose rose gold and silver pump head.
query: Ugh, my cat knocked over my potted succulent this morning and got soil all over the throw rug by the couch, then I realized I was out of oat milk so I had to run to the corner store before the rain picked up, and on the walk over I saw a kid chasing a squirrel that stole a french fry right out of their takeout bag. I’ve heard the refillable containers in rose gold with the silver pump head are usually priced under 30 dollars here.
